record.question: The most definitive treatment for eclampsia is:
record.explanation: Answer C: Immediate delivery of the baby. Eclampsia requires immediate seizure stabilization and maternal management followed by delivery once stabilized; delivery is the definitive treatment for the pregnancy-related disease. Source/context note: Stabilize airway/breathing/circulation and control seizures before delivery; delivery timing/mode are individualized. Reference: https://www.acog.org/clinical/clinical-guidance/practice-bulletin/articles/2020/06/gestational-hypertension-and-preeclampsia. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
